title: The Recipe with Two Jobs
youtube_title: The Recipe with Two Jobs | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a recipe split into stirring and reading will go wrong if one person rushes. Vera and Arun split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
